create_MultiSeqWrapper: create a MultiSeqWrapper to pass video tensors through a backbone encoder with optional masking and gram mode
run_MultiSeqWrapper_forward: run MultiSeqWrapper forward pass on a list of tensors with different sequence lengths and masks
create_PredictorMultiSeqWrapper: create a PredictorMultiSeqWrapper to apply encoder and predictor masks for masked autoencoding
run_PredictorMultiSeqWrapper_forward: run PredictorMultiSeqWrapper forward pass to produce predicted and context outputs for video modeling
refactor_MultiSeqWrapper_gram_mode: refactor MultiSeqWrapper gram_mode path to upsample input, run backbone, and downscale output to original 2D size
